messages:
elaine-partner: Quick sync — final checklist for marketplace + HW partner + SI joint GTM. Can folks confirm status for items below? We need all green by EOD Wed so marketing can lock publish times.

sam-eng: On integrations: demo env for SI flows is up. Need final partner creds from Paul, and a small schema tweak (embedding size) applied — will patch tonight.

paul-sis: Sending creds now (DM). Also seconding the schema tweak — we tested with Acme hardware telemetry and it reduced latency.

marta-marketing: Press/blog plan: embargo lift target is Thu 09:00 PT. Blog posts staged in CMS, hero image versions (web/og) are in the asset pack: https://redwood.ai/marketplace/assets. Need final quote from HW partner + approved product blurb from legal.

leo-legal: Reviewing PR language now. Two asks: (1) remove forward-looking revenue phrasing in partner quote; (2) confirm customer data flow description for Private deployments. Can we get the draft copy in the thread?

elaine-partner: Pasting current blurb below (short):
```
Redwood Inference and TitanCompute are partnering to bring optimized LLM inference to on-prem and marketplace customers, combining Redwood's runtime with TitanCompute's accelerator nodes to deliver predictable latency and cost-efficiency.
```

leo-legal: Ok on first pass — tweak: replace "cost-efficiency" with "improved cost predictability". Also need partner permission to use TitanCompute logo on landing page — Paul, confirm legal approval on their side.

paul-sis: Confirmed via email earlier — they approved logo usage. I'll forward the signed asset license to Leo.

marta-marketing: For tracking: please use these UTMs on joint links: `?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=titancompute_launch_v1` — will set campaign in GA. Also need final landing page CTA copy and 2 customer quotes.

sam-eng: Integration demo checklist:
- demo tenant with sample data (done)
- SI flow: data in -> inference -> downstream aggregator (in progress)
- performance dashboard link (staging) -> https://staging.redwood.ai/perf/titan-demo
I can run a dry-run Wed 17:00 PT.

marta-marketing: Wed 17:00 PT dry-run noted. Can Ops and Deployers be on call? We'll simulate press pickup.

vik-ops: I'll be available Wed 17:00. Need to confirm staging cutover schedule to avoid job collisions. Deploy-bot will run a preflight at +30m before the dry-run.

deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY CHECK: staging branch deployed to marketplace-staging at 2680012500. No breaking migrations detected. :white_check_mark:

elaine-partner: Outstanding items + owners:
- final partner quote (Paul)
- legal signoff on PR + landing copy (Leo)
- hero OG and web images (Marta has)
- marketplace listing copy + SKU details (Sam + Paul)
- SI demo runbook (Sam)
- dry-run logistics chat (all)
If anyone cannot hit their commit, shout now.

paul-sis: I'll get quote by Tue EOD and forward signed logo license to Leo.

leo-legal: I'll finish review Tue night, will add inline edits to the PR doc and ping here.

marta-marketing: I'll lock down the CMS publish window once I have Leo's final. Also coordinating with PR distribution partner — embargo window will be enforced.

sam-eng: One tech note: marketplace listing needs a max token limit param set to avoid OOM on small instances. I'll add the field to the manifest and share diff here.

elaine-partner: Great. Final ask: can someone post a tiny runbook snippet for support if press traffic spikes? We need a one-pager with contact points (eng, ops, sales).

vik-ops: Creating a shortops doc now and will paste link here shortly. Basic escalation: #incidents -> ops oncall -> eng lead -> partner SE.

marta-marketing: Also we want a short Slack channel for live launch: #launch-titancompute. I'll create and invite everyone.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULE: staging dry-run Wed 17:00 PT (2680013000). Production window set Thu 09:00 PT (2680099600). Preflight at Wed 16:30 PT (2680012800).

elaine-partner: Thanks everyone — this thread will be the single source of truth for signoffs. I'll compile a final checklist doc after Tue EOD and tag here. :thumbsup:

marta-marketing: 👍

sam-eng: LGTM

paul-sis: thumbs up

leo-legal: Approved pending minor wording change (will update).

vik-ops: On it.
